question: Should I buy a house in Toronto or keep renting?

content.text:
I can't tell you whether to buy or keep renting. That depends on your finances, how long you plan to stay, your risk tolerance and where rates go, and I only have StatCan data. I also can't forecast prices or rents.

I can pull Toronto figures that bear on the decision, such as:
- the New Housing Price Index
- rent levels or the rent component of the CPI
- shelter cost trends

Tell me which of these you want and I'll fetch them. A mortgage calculator or a financial advisor can then help you weigh them against your own situation.
